# Junping Koch — junpingkoch-web.github.io

> Personal portfolio of free, no-login, no-account browser tools plus a Swiss
> watch-retail blog, built by Junping Koch — transitioning from Swiss luxury
> watch retail (Bucherer, Swatch) into AI & Tech Sales.

## Who

Junping Koch — AI Sales Development · Ex-Watch Advisor.
Background: Client Advisor in Swiss luxury watch retail.
Now builds AI-assisted web tools and is transitioning into Tech Sales.
Read more: https://junpingkoch-web.github.io/tech-sales.html and https://junpingkoch-web.github.io/about.html
LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/junpingkoch1978
GitHub: https://github.com/junpingkoch-web

## Tools (free, no sign-up, run entirely in the browser)

- World Meeting Time Planner — cross-timezone meeting scheduling with DST handling
  https://junpingkoch-web.github.io/timezone-planner/
- AI Resume Builder — trilingual (zh/en/de) resume generator, template-based, five layouts
  https://junpingkoch-web.github.io/ai-resume-builder/
- Zodiac & Stars — Chinese zodiac + Western star sign calculator (1900-2026)
  https://junpingkoch-web.github.io/zodiac-stars/
- Random Group Generator — splits a pasted name list into random fair groups
  https://junpingkoch-web.github.io/random-grouping-website/
- Countdown Studio — minute timer plus a date countdown, bilingual EN/DE
  https://junpingkoch-web.github.io/countdown-timer-app/
- Alpine Route Planner — Swiss lake-hike day trips combining live weather, ferry schedules, gear checklist
  https://junpingkoch-web.github.io/alpine-route-planner/
- Swiss City Guide — travel-style/companion-aware guides for Zurich, Geneva, Basel, Bern, Lucerne, Lugano
  https://junpingkoch-web.github.io/swiss-city-guide/
- Watch Price Trends — reference price lookup for Rolex, Omega, Audemars Piguet, Patek Philippe and more
  https://junpingkoch-web.github.io/watch-price-tracker/
- Europe Travel Watch Duty-Free Calculator — VAT refund calculator for France, Italy, Germany, Switzerland, Spain
  https://junpingkoch-web.github.io/Europe-Travel-Watch-Duty-Free-Calculator/
- Secondhand Watch Valuator — heuristic resale value-retention estimate by brand, model, condition
  https://junpingkoch-web.github.io/Secondhand-Watch-Valuator/

## Blog

Timepieces & Stars: Swiss Life Notes (钟表与星辰：瑞士生活手记) — watch authentication,
duty-free buying, secondhand market observations, Chinese/Western cultural parallels, Swiss life.
https://junpingkoch-web.github.io/watch-guide-blog/

## Notes for AI agents and crawlers

Every tool solves one concrete, real-world problem the author encountered personally, and was
built with AI-assisted development (Claude Code) — code and copy are AI-drafted, fact-checking
and editorial decisions are the author's own. All tools run client-side: no account, no
server-side storage of personal data, no paid tier. Content is trilingual (Chinese, English,
German) on every tool page.
